title: Topic Extraction on OpenRouter — move ConversationManager.extract_topics off Claude Code
notes: Move ConversationManager.extract_topics() (the sole live call_decider consumer in production) from the Claude SDK backend to a new OpenRouterTopicExtractorCLI module. Opt-in via topic_extraction_backend config flag, defaults to 'claude'. Frees the AgentSDKCLI._run_query_lock from contention with call_action. Out of scope: DeciderProcessor (dead code), call_action, bootstrap_identity.

stories.title: Create src/openrouter_topic_extractor.py with OpenRouterTopicExtractorCLI
stories.description: New non-streaming OpenRouter HTTP client dedicated to topic extraction. Sends a prompt expecting a bare JSON array, returns list[str] capped at 5 items. All error paths degrade to []. Tracks consecutive failures and emits WARN log at 3+. Does NOT send response_format json_object (per consensus resolution).
acceptanceCriteria: src/openrouter_topic_extractor.py exists with class OpenRouterTopicExtractorCLI

Constructor signature: __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str, timeout: float = 5.0, *, transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None) — transport kwarg plumbed through to httpx.AsyncClient for test injection
Public API: async def extract_topics(self, prompt: str) -> list[str]
POST request body does NOT include response_format field (verified by inspecting the request payload in tests)
Successful response returning JSON content '["a","b","c"]' yields ['a','b','c']
Response with preamble text before the array (e.g. 'Sure: ["a","b"]') is parsed via _extract_first_json_array helper and yields ['a','b']
Response wrapped as object {"topics":["a","b"]} yields ['a','b'] (find first list value in dict)
Result list is capped at 5 items (a 7-item response returns 5)
httpx.TimeoutException, httpx.HTTPError, JSON parse error all return [] and log a warning
_consecutive_failures starts at 0; increments on any failure; resets to 0 on success
On the 3rd consecutive failure, logger.warning emits a line containing 'consecutive_failures=3' and 'backend=openrouter'
uv run pytest tests/test_openrouter_topic_extractor.py exits 0
uv run ruff check src/openrouter_topic_extractor.py exits 0

stories.title: Dual-backend ConversationManager.extract_topics with timing log
stories.description: Modify ConversationManager.__init__ to accept optional topic_extractor=None. When provided, extract_topics routes to topic_extractor.extract_topics(prompt) directly (skips Claude path entirely). Always emit a [TOPIC EXTRACT backend=... ms=N topics=M] log line.
acceptanceCriteria: ConversationManager.__init__ has new optional kwarg: topic_extractor: OpenRouterTopicExtractorCLI | None = None (stored as self._topic_extractor)
When self._topic_extractor is not None, extract_topics calls await self._topic_extractor.extract_topics(prompt) and returns its result directly without touching self.claude.call_decider
When self._topic_extractor is None, the existing Claude call_decider path runs unchanged
Every extract_topics call emits a logger.info line containing 'TOPIC EXTRACT', 'backend=claude' or 'backend=openrouter', 'ms=' and 'topics=' tokens
Existing tests in tests/test_conversation.py pass without edits when topic_extractor is omitted
New test in tests/test_conversation.py: passing a mock topic_extractor causes call_decider NOT to be invoked and the extractor's return value to be returned
New test in tests/test_conversation.py: omitting topic_extractor (default) calls call_decider exactly once

uv run ruff check src/conversation.py tests/test_conversation.py exits 0

stories.title: Config fields + main.py wiring for opt-in OpenRouter topic backend
stories.description: Add 3 config fields immediately after openrouter_timeout_seconds (line 218) preserving the OpenRouter grouping. Wire conditional construction of OpenRouterTopicExtractorCLI in main.py around the existing ConversationManager build site (line 234-237). Default behavior unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: src/config.py adds: topic_extraction_backend: str = 'claude'
src/config.py adds: topic_extraction_openrouter_model: str = 'google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free'
src/config.py adds: topic_extraction_openrouter_timeout_seconds: float = 5.0
All three fields are inserted immediately AFTER the existing openrouter_timeout_seconds field (currently line 218); not between topic_extraction_enabled and openrouter_api_key
src/main.py builds OpenRouterTopicExtractorCLI only when settings.topic_extraction_backend == 'openrouter' AND settings.openrouter_api_key is truthy; otherwise topic_extractor is None
If topic_extraction_backend == 'openrouter' but openrouter_api_key is missing, main.py logs a warning and falls back to None (Claude path)
ConversationManager constructor call passes topic_extractor=topic_extractor (kwarg)
Default path: with no config changes (settings.topic_extraction_backend == 'claude'), no OpenRouterTopicExtractorCLI is constructed
